steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: I've been hearing you reported Olmer Ingra to the National Council?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: True...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: If a fatality during the Major isn't enough to warrant punishment, then what does the law even...

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: We're all well aware of how the National Council operates, Malkiewicz, my man. You had to deal plenty enough with them in your entrepreneurial life, didn't you?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Don't spend too long at a loss. You have a trip to the Infected intake-treatment zone in a short while. You need to make the Knights Association and a few healthcare firms see eye to eye.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Think on the bright side. This work is saving lives in and of itself, isn't it?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Don't get too worn out. You'll grind yourself to dust at this rate. If you'll excuse me, I'm off to a meeting.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: ...*Sigh*.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Hello, Malkiewicz speaking...

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Spokesman Malkiewicz, hope you're having a good day.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: I'm a deputy justice of the National Council. Your suit has reached us, Spokesman.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Ah...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: How do you plan to proceed?

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: It is the obligation of a spokesperson to report those knights out of line with the regulations of the General Chamber. As such, we will prioritize our considerations your... complaints against Brassrust Knight.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: However, matters with said Knight Olmer Ingra are somewhat complex.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: You should be aware it was not long ago that Ingra's application for bail was given fresh approval by the National Council; to try him again now could have adverse implications for the National Council's authority.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: We consider, of course... that the spokesperson's demand equates to the Board of Directors' demand. Such as is the only interpretation we can make, we would not refuse you.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Which is why we're having this call. I understand. What are the National Council's conditions?

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Oh... conditions? Please, not in those terms. I hope you understand this to be a perfunctory business call.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Mr. Czarny suffered banishment external to proceedings; that was beyond many expectations. Even we do not consider Mr. Czarny's mistake to be so irredeemable.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: But regardless, the past is the past. Czarny has left the Grand Knight Territory and been deprived of his place as a spokesman.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: But because of the abruptness of this banishment, we have not been able to appropriately—handle the aftermath, with regards to all parties.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: The Rose Paper Union is a patron of Brassrust. That is Mr. Czarny's personal handiwork.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: He is privy to too much... Mr. Malkiewicz, do you understand?

a.text: I hear my own heart thumping.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I... don't understand...

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: If you can ensure Mr. Czarny never again will be an issue for us... then we will be sure to punish Brassrust with the full force of the law.

a.text: I've never imagined something like this would be happening to me.
No, actually, I have. I just never thought it would be my decision.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: So... you mean... I should...

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: I understand the Major has your hands full. It need not be straight away. You need only agree that you will have Mr. Czarny disappear in a respectable manner, and I will leave at once to make the arrangements.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Of course, in the wake of Mr. Czarny's disappearance, we may also come to establish... a deep bond of reliance.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I'm sorry, I'm afraid I can't give you an answer right now.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: That is very regrettable. We hope you will make your mind up as soon as possible; Sir Brassrust Knight's suspension is by no standards a long one.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: We welcome your call any time, Mr. Malkiewicz. May you have a wonderful day.

steps.name: A Person at the Door
steps.text: Mr. Malkiewicz? Are you there?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: C-Come in...

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Uh... Mr. Malkiewicz... I'm sorry to disturb you.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: To tell the truth, uh, I haven't been sleeping well lately. I got the notice I'd be MCing a whole bunch of the Major's events, and I'm honored... but...

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Can I ask if I've been getting any complaints recently? I heard some people aren't happy with how I perform now, saying they liked the old style better.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I think we'll be hard-pressed to get a direct answer from the Board. Sorry, Mob. Just proceed with caution.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: *Sigh*... There's a huge bonus on the line once I'm done commentating for the Major, right?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: So long as you don't slip up.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Say... what kind of place is your hometown? The...

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The City of Artisans?

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Ha, who's asking these days. It's a little old place... used to be pretty famous, but now it's just a tired, backwards city.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: That's why I came to the Grand Knight Territory. Needed another way to make my life happen. You get me, right?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I'll help you as much as I can to get your word out, Mr. Mob. You've worked very hard...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: ...They won't trouble you... they wouldn't.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: ...Doctor.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: What are you looking at?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Ah... the Infected shelter and treatment. It's an initiative they only started in the last few years. It's got a long way to go.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: But even for you, Doctor, I say you're better off not prying too deeply~

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Infected knights have been a thorn in the side of all the great nobles. If Rhodes Island wants a premier business contract, then it's important to know when to bite your tongue.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: The K.G.C.C... Their pamphlets really do dampen your day.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: If you're finding it dull, Doctor, I could accompany you on a strollabout. So long as I'm with you, even a little trip to the commercial districts won't fall out of line.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Of course... if you're more inclined to stay in here, I won't meddle.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: The Major... ahh.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Come to think of it, the Rhodes Islanders all seem tied up with the Radiant Knight.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Are you worried about her? Heh-heh... I'm jealous...

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Competition knights are always in the public eye, but you... care for her as a 'companion,' don't you?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: It's a novel feeling, the Radiant Knight somewhere other than Kazimierz—how is a knight regarded, I wonder, in the world beyond her country?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: By the way, Doctor.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: You have a meeting in a bit, with a spokesman from the General Chamber of Commerce.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Spokespeople for the K.G.C.C. are the cream of the crop from all walks of life, chosen by the board, each with their own duty, handling all sorts of affairs large and small for the Major.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: They're not the highest tier of authority, but they're channels to it. Seeing how a Chamber mouthpiece has asked to meet you by name, I'd like you to be a little careful.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Come what may, I will be responsible for your safety throughout your stay in Kazimierz. I'll be as close as your shadow.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Uh oh, what's that look on your face for now? Do you still not trust me? I can't help but feel a little hurt...

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: But relax. So long as I'm by your side... you'll be perfectly safe.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: If you have doubts about my loyalty... if I do anything that worries you, then Rhodes Island can punish me however you want...

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: ...any way you want.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Excuse me... is this the room where {@nickname} from Rhodes Island is staying?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Ah, Madam Knight... who might you be?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Fourth-order knight 'Gravel,' serving as a security consultant for the Doctor and other Rhodes Islanders, for as long as they stay in Kazimierz.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: I've been appointed by the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi, Mr. Spokesman. Please don't mind me, and continue with your work.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Take a seat, {@nickname}, and as for you, er... Miss Gravel, if your post allows for it, by all means relax as well.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: I'd rather stand and keep a nice, firm grip on the situation.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: ...Okay.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: You're here representing Rhodes Island?

options: Would it shock you if I said no?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Nice to meet you.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Er... haha, I guess you're not exactly the sociable type. But that won't at all spoil my... respect for you.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Erm? Maybe... I just heard the company's representative was staying nearby.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: You're joking, right? You must be {@nickname}... haha, you've got a sense of humor.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Ahem.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I'm Spokesman Malkiewicz of the General Chamber of Commerce... Just Malkiewicz is fine.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I've been over my information about Rhodes Island Pharmaceuticals. I don't have any relevant background in it, but keeping up the fight against Oripathy... it can't be easy.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: We're very much thankful for the contributions you're making to the Kazimierz Major Project. Have you looked over the terms yet?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Rhodes Island will be acting as a collaborating firm, standing as a unit of the 'medical group,' forming the 'Kazimierz Alliance Medical Organization for the Treatment of Infected.'

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: The Organization is under direct purview of the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi... of course, the Knights Association and our own people will make every effort to cooperate with your work as well.

options: The Adeptus... the Knights Association, and 'you.'

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: That's right... In the Grand Knight Territory, you can't avoid dealing with multiple fronts of power. I believe you'll get used to it.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: If you have any questions at all, please feel free to speak up. It's my duty to give answers to our foreign guests, Doctor.

options: But I've heard it's the 'K.G.C.C.' we should watch out for.
Are there other Infected here besides the knights?
What do you think? About our... firm.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Ah... you seem to have misunderstood. My position is 'spokesman,' but summarily, I represent the 'General Chamber of Commerce' itself.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: The General Chamber is the organizer of the Kazimierz Major, as well as an indispensable trade group to Kazimierz.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Actually, though the medical group is nominally the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi's purview, all funding and movement of supplies is within the Chamber's control.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Therefore, we must value the K.G.C.C.'s intents.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Er... perhaps... I'm not sure.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: But this project is solely aimed to serve Infected knights lawfully registered with the Knights Association, knight trainees, and candidates.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: If we had... for example, an unlucky civilian infected in a workplace injury...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Though they wouldn't be covered by the remit, if they could afford it, they would also be eligible to apply for treatment and shelter.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: ...If they could afford it.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Me? Haha... you're asking me?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: If I'm completely honest, Infected are far from a part of my life... ah, don't misunderstand me...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: All I mean is that fighting to keep a hold of yourself in a hectic city, scrambling about to live and work... that's an everyday state of affairs for the vast majority.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I know little to nothing about the other countries across our world, but... protecting a group of sick discriminated against for their illness—that can't be a bad thing, can it?

options: But are all Kazimierzians really willing to lend a hand to the Infected?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: By all rights, I shouldn't be discussing this with you, but... ahem.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: The Infected knight system was structured by the Adeptus and the K.G.C.C.'s Managing Director in concert, fresh in the wake of the Blood Knight's win.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Oh, of course, its premise and scope revolves around 'competition knights.' The lady over there isn't accounted for; the army has their own regulations for handling Infected.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Infected have a special format to go through—it's an additional step we usually call the 'Wipe Out Qualifier,' to prove their ability to, well, be knights.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: If there do happen to be promising athletes among the Infected, then the General Chamber of Commerce doesn't mind cleaning up their identities for them.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Have... have you seen the papers recently? Even now, quite a few are still opposed to this whole thing.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: But at least the Infected don't need to die in misery. In my mind, that's already a big improvement.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Regarding all of you at Rhodes Island... the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi considers you to be an agency with ample experience in dealing with the Infected.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: This is why we'd like you to take charge of physical examinations on the 'Infected knights,' and formulate treatment plans over the Major.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Treatment plans, huh?

options: Can you give me an idea of the scale of the issue?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Scale? The Infected knights total less than 7% of all competing. Though that's only the count of Infected knights legally registered with the Knights Association.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: If you count everyone, the knight candidates, trainees, and the Infected who were forced to give their nobility under a different identity...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: It's a number worth worrying about. And that's another reason why we're here, discussing this.

options: It seems there's been bad rumors around lately.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: You can guess how many Kazimierzians are prejudiced against the Infected.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I'll be open with you; the original intent of the Alliance Medical Organization was to appease the populace, by way of systematically treating and administering the Infected knights.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: My wording might've struck you as distasteful, but they're ill after all... and we can't ignore that objective, er, discrepancy. Sorry to put it that way.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Of course, if there's anything at all we can help with, you need only ask.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: At the least... I hope every good knight—can go out with a happy ending.

options: Can you tell me about what goes on with the K.G.C.C.?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Er, sorry, I have some business to attend to. If I get the chance, I'd be happy to have dinner with you.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: But, er, what part of it did you want to know about?

options: It's a business entity representing a country. I have lots of questions.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Sorry I'm late.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Margaret!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: What happened? What was all the talk of you getting carried off by the Candle Knight?!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: What did that woman tell you? Did she threaten you? Was the General Chamber of Commerce—

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Calm down, Zofia.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: We were just dodging reporters, that's all.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: The Candle Knight Droste, eh? Always been an enigma, she has...

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: But she's probably in the top three knights of Kazimierz, based on popularity alone. The turnover on her birthday each year'd be enough to build a whole fort.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: What sort of knight is she?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Why are you so like Maria? Listen, you need to pay a little more attention to the rivals around you.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: You're here for me, aren't you?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Sweet-talking me won't get you anywhere.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: She's an astronomical rising star. People even call her 'the second Black Knight.'

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: She comes from Leithanien, and has a terrifying talent for Arts, an aristocratic upbringing, fine looks, and meteoric fame for her accomplishments.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: With all that plus her opaque background adding to the scent of mystery around her, practically overnight, the Candle Knight became one of Kazimierz's household names and a Grand Knight.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: The media is still digging into how she leads her private life...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: But she's by no means just for show.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: She's very young, and very fierce.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I met plenty of supremely talented Casters during my roaming days. Victorians, Leithanians, and... Infected.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Even the most outstanding Caster in the world would find it hard to challenge the qualities she exudes. She may not be a soldier, but I won't underestimate her.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: The Black Knight's a very unusual case of Leithanian. She was no good at even the slightest bit of Arts. It's as though she was born to be martial.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: That age has come and gone, but I don't think anyone could forget the sheer impression she left, brandishing her massive armaments about.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: And the Candle Knight, on the flip end of the spectrum, she's practically a 'model' Leithanian knight.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: We don't know what the core of her Arts is, exactly, but the word 'Candle' is absolutely reflective of her equipment's form and her fighting style.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Margaret... is she your next opponent?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: In two days. It'll be a bitter fight, and we don't have long to prepare... Where's Maria?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: She's at home resting... Are...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Are you smiling?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Hm? Am I?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: ...I predicted you would refuse, Miss Droste.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: But the General Chamber wants no more of the Radiant Knight winning left and right like this. We must ensure, at least, that she falls to the loser's bracket.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Strange... Wouldn't it have been easier if you didn't give amnesty to the Radiant Knight to begin with?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Well... That's...

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: 'The General Chamber of Commerce is never fastened as one.'

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Please! You... must not say anything of the sort, not where you might be heard.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: The Board of Directors is sure to have internal disputes, there's no doubt of that, but if a knight like you were to express such opinions, I worry it'd impact your status.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: My apologies... you must have it just as hard, McKee.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Ah... yes, thank you for your concern...

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: In short, I'll be working to mediate for you, even if you aren't willing to use any 'special tricks' against the Radiant Knight.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: But I'd like for you to understand: though you've refused the Board of Directors's proposal, they will adopt other methods. The situation may, perhaps, evolve towards some extreme...

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: The Armorless Union, you mean.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: If possible, I'd like for you to prevent such circumstances from taking hold.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Miss Droste... *sigh* That's far beyond me to promise.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Heh... come to speak of it, is the Board of Directors so untrusting in my power? As a knight, that really does give me mixed feelings.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: No, that's absolutely not the case, I assure you.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: The Grand Knights at the forefront of the Major all, without a doubt, have the power to rival the apex knights of any country.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: But opposingly, once you step into this domain, once you near the so-called 'limit,' the gaps shrink in size.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: The uncertain elements will only grow... isn't that so?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: I have no intent of putting you in a predicament. I know how the Board of Directors thinks.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: You can go now. I'll look into this... Radiant Knight.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Good. I'll leave the competition tapes and personal files you need here, then.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: The Radiant Knight seems to have changed vastly since her banishment, I need to warn you of that.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Yes... hence why I wanted to meet her.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Margaret Nearl... Margaret Nearl... hm.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Despises the knight tournament industry, granddaughter of a war hero. The Nearl family's pegasus, yet a high-profile champion of the Major too...

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Said to be noble, yet she gives off the air of a campaign knight. Has she seen war and death for herself...?

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: No, she must have.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Then has she transcended death before? Has she truly dreamed of casting off the fetters and chains?

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Or has she already stridden over a whole new boundary?

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Heheh, Margaret. How much she seems like... a true knight.
